items.footerDescription: Mobile vehicle servicing and repairs, with the honest, reliable, affordable care Charlie’s known for.

items.title: Oil & Filter Change
items.description: Engine oil and oil filter replacement using the correct manufacturer-recommended oil specification for your vehicle.

items.title: Interim Service
items.description: Routine maintenance to help keep your vehicle running as it should between full services.
items.interval: Recommended every 6,000 miles or 6 months, whichever comes first.
items.included:
Engine oil & filter
Essential fluid checks & top-ups
General vehicle health check

items.title: Full Service
items.description: A thorough scheduled service, including an engine air filter replacement.
items.interval: Recommended every 12,000 miles or 12 months, whichever comes first.
items.included:
Engine oil & filter
Engine air filter
Essential fluid checks & top-ups
General vehicle health check

items.title: Major Service
items.description: Comprehensive scheduled maintenance tailored to your manufacturer’s service schedule.
items.interval: Recommended every 24,000 miles or 24 months, subject to manufacturer schedules.
items.included:
Engine oil & filters
Cabin and fuel filters where applicable
Spark plugs where applicable
Brake fluid when due
Comprehensive vehicle health check

items.title: Gearbox Oil Change
items.description: Gearbox oil replacement using the correct manufacturer-recommended specification, with filter replacement where applicable.
items.included:
Correct gearbox oil specification
Filter replacement where applicable

items.title: Brake Fluid Change
items.description: Brake fluid replacement using the correct specification for your vehicle to help maintain reliable braking performance.
items.included:
Vehicle-specified brake fluid
Replacement when due

items.title: Battery Replacement
items.description: Supply and professional fitting of a suitable replacement vehicle battery.

items.title: Brake Repairs & Replacement
items.description: Supply and fitting of replacement brake pads and discs to help maintain safe, reliable braking performance.
items.included:
Replacement brake pads
Replacement brake discs

items.heroDescription: From regular servicing to brakes, batteries and oil changes, Charlie brings practical vehicle care to you.
items.featuredSectionTitle: Good care for the miles ahead.
items.featuredSectionDescription: From an oil and filter change to routine servicing and brake replacements, explore practical care for your vehicle.
items.calloutDescription: Call, email or message Charlie to ask about a service or request a quote.

items.heroDescription: Explore Charlie’s vehicle servicing, maintenance and repair options. Need to check what is right for your vehicle? Get in touch to ask or request a quote.
items.calloutTitle: Have a question or need a quote?
items.calloutDescription: Talk to Charlie about your vehicle and the service you have in mind.
items.footnote: Service intervals are recommendations. Major service items are subject to your vehicle manufacturer’s schedule, and some replacements apply only where relevant or due.
